email.subject: Anchor Group Fitness: a couple quick fixes
email.body:
Hi Jack,

I checked Anchor Group Fitness's site. Two things are likely costing you members: it isn't mobile-friendly (most people search for gyms on their phone, and a broken mobile layout sends them straight to a competitor), and there's no way to book a class or trial session online, so interested people have to call during business hours or just give up.

The site also loads slowly from heavy images and doesn't list your hours anywhere, both of which add friction right when someone's deciding whether to visit.

I fix stuff like this for a flat fee. Happy to do a free 10-minute walkthrough showing exactly what's losing you sign-ups, no obligation.

Worth a quick look?

Alex
